name: RDARS Inc.
summary: RDARS Inc. is a burgeoning drone technology firm specializing in autonomous security systems. This early-stage company develops and markets solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial sectors. Its offerings include a proprietary suite of self-operating robotic platforms, specifically drone aircraft, dedicated drone stations, and unmanned autonomous ground vehicles. These advanced systems are engineered to provide real-time alarm response, situation verification, proactive intervention, detailed reporting, and secure evidence recording. Established in 2019, RDARS Inc. maintains its headquarters in North York, Canada.
